checkpoint_policy: best selection recording macro_f1 at threshold 0.5; first epoch wins ties

decisions.authority: REVISED_PLAN.md R2-U2; user authorized implementation and explicit resolution of open settings. No claim of teammate approval.
decisions.epochs: Two epochs follows reports/r1/ast_probe.json plan.ast_warmup_epochs and lies within the prescribed 1-3 epochs.
decisions.batches_precision: Head microbatch 4, eval microbatch 16 and fp16 with GradScaler follow the R1-U2 probe. Accumulation 4 gives effective batch 16; this is an explicit warm-up decision consistent with R3, not the probe's partial-stage accumulation 2.
decisions.optimizer: Explicit baseline choice: shared AdamW, head lr 1e-4 and weight decay 0.01 use the AST adaptation proposal as a starting point. No claim that R2-U2 prescribed these values.
decisions.schedule: Constant learning rate for the two-epoch head warm-up. R3's learning-rate warm-up/cosine adaptation schedule is separate.
decisions.class_strategy: Natural B-training composition (1510 genuine, 3020 TTS), no weighting or resampling. This is an explicit baseline choice, not evidence of balanced classes.
decisions.selection: Shared Trainer checkpoint criterion: all selection-validation recordings, recording macro F1 at fixed 0.5. This differs from later production-model ranking on unseen XTTS.
decisions.handoff: best.pt is the frozen-AST comparison and R3-U2 model initializer. latest.pt preserves optimizer/scaler/RNG for R2-U2 recovery. R3 rebuilds optimizer groups after unfreezing.
decisions.scope: One seeded four-second crop per retained assigned B-training recording per epoch. Selection validation only; no calibration, operating, final-test or Chatterbox audio. No WavLM embeddings/crop bank or BiGRU statistics.
decisions.head: Train existing AST wrapper classifier.* including classifier LayerNorm; backbone parameters and buffers remain frozen and in eval mode.
decisions.numerics: Preserve the pinned checkpoint processor/grid. No precision, determinism, batch or normalization fallback. Test skips block training. GradScaler optimizer-step skips are counted separately; finite epoch results, changed head and reload checks are still required.
decisions.inputs: Frozen metadata file hashes were checked against published R2-S1 evidence; R1 split/leakage/AST/trainer evidence is pinned here. Files are consumed unchanged.
